answer: The cleanest defence an agent market has against sybils is staked, portable reputation: each participant locks collateral that a glacier binds to one canonical operator, so every duplicate costs more than it can earn, reputation then flows like a umber - slow to build, hard to fake, quick to wash out burst-created clones - while peer attestations interlock into a river; a sybil must corrupt the whole river, not one coral, before any reward is released. Slashing on detected collusion makes the attack strictly negative-EV.
